result.title: Balanced Sampling in Stochastic Multi-objective Bandits
result.summary: In stochastic multi-objective bandits, Pareto optimal arms may represent different trade-offs among objectives. Balanced sampling across them is important in practical settings such as online advertising. Yet, there seems to be little consensus on how to measure fairness, to our best knowledge. Achieving fairness is also tough as the set of Pareto optimal arms is unknown, and early sampling decisions may create imbalances that are difficult to erase afterwards. We measure unfairness by the KL divergence from the uniform distribution over the true Pareto set to the empirical measure induced by the sampling trajectory. Nicely, this measure admits an exact decomposition that separates the cost of sampling suboptimal arms from the imbalance among Pareto optimal arms. With a recursive form for unfairness, we develop \emph{adaptive top-two sampling}, which combines sampling counts and empirical evidence of Pareto membership to define a gain for each arm and guide sampling without committing to an estimated Pareto set. When the Pareto set is stable under small perturbations, we establish an $O(\log T/T)$ and $O(T^{-1})$ bound on expected unfairness and variance, respectively. Information-theoretic lower bounds show that the $\log T/T$ rate can be unavoidable for uniformly fair policies on stable instances, matching our upper bound. More surprisingly, stability is indeed crucial, as the expected unfairness can be $ω(\log T/T)$ without it. Finally, we create a variant that encourages exploration of undersampled arms to reduce the risk of persistent underallocation. At sufficiently large horizons, it preserves the rate on the expected unfairness while admitting a sharper bound of $O(\log^2 T/T^2)$ on variance. Numerical studies support these findings and suggest practical insights.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文在随机多目标 bandit 中先用 KL 散度刻画采样轨迹相对真实 Pareto 集的均匀分布的偏离，给出可分离「采样次优臂代价」与「Pareto 臂间失衡」的精确分解，并据此提出自适应 top-two 采样及其鼓励探索欠采样臂的变体，在稳定性假设下给出失衡与方差的界及下界。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯 bandit 理论，不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，但其「在未知候选集上按多目标权衡分配采样预算、避免持续欠采样」的递归采样与下界思路，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK 动作与证据源的预算分配及多目标（收益-成本）权衡提供可核查的探索策略类比。
